parts.name: Engine Block
parts.description: Keeps the ship moving when it matters, and it will take any hull that's still got something left to push.

parts.name: Hull Plate
parts.description: Patched, dented and still holding the air in, which is more than the factory ever promised for this one.

parts.name: Shield Generator
parts.description: Throws up a bubble against the worst of the universe, and fits a fighter's pride just as well as a freighter's cargo.

parts.name: Thruster
parts.description: Gives the ship its shove out of the bay, and it doesn't care whether the hull is armored or just stubborn.

parts.name: Power Core
parts.description: The heart of the ship's power, bolted in with care, and it runs the same whether the pilot is brave or just lucky.
